notes: The game versions the mod is built for (docs/GAME_VERSIONS.md). One source tree, one build per game: `node packaging/build-release.mjs --game <id>`. A variant's Scripts and Runtime carry its suffix in their file names and a `game` field in both release.json files; the files of packaging/game-variants/<id>/ (laid out like the game folder) replace the same-named files of the Scripts package. The optional packs (Local AI, Mature, microphone, OmniVoice, language packs) hold no game-dependent file and are shared. `requirements` is what the player installs for that game (documentation and the Nexus page; the in-game setup check names the Native Settings UI version from the translated text in mod/setup-check.lua, which carries the same number).

requirements.red4ext: wopss/RED4ext master 47ac01c or newer (2.5 support merged, no official release yet)
